items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, by default it only encodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level since it allows combined usage with other general purpose converters without conflicts. Alternative constructors with a Predicate<ResolvableType> parameter can be used to customize this behavior.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，默认情况下仅对带有@Serializable注解的类型（在类型或泛型级别）进行编码，因为它允许与其他通用转换器结合使用且不会产生冲突。可以使用带有Predicate<ResolvableType>参数的替代构造函数来自定义此行为。
